funzione: The forms that identify a truly personal pronoun. The part of speech “p” is not enough, because it includes relatives, demonstratives and indefinites. The lemma ὅς is excluded separately because it is a relative.
fonte: Grammar: Smyth (1920) § 325 (with § 325 a, d, D). The list does not contain the unaccented μου, μοι, σου, σοι, οὑ, οἱ nor the dual σφώ, σφῷν. It decides which tokens the check personal-pronoun-person examines, and it must therefore be defended form by form.
